note: All coords in main.webp px (1871x2400). Draw order: sky (opaque, full frame; its area below the horizon is synthesized) -> far -> mid -> rock -> wanderer; sky+far+mid+rock+wanderer reproduces main.webp. rock.webp is the summit with the wanderer removed (rock under his legs synthesized); plate_noman.webp is the flat painting without him. rock_ext.webp continues the foreground rock below the frame: its row 0 sits at y=extY (top 12 rows fade in over the painting's own rock), height extH, full width; rows >= H of the painting are pure synthesis. fog_mask.webp: grey = fog density 0..1 (R channel), same frame as main. depth: 0 back .. 3 front; wanderer shares depth 3 with rock.

plate_noman.note: flat painting with the wanderer removed; the rock pinnacle hidden behind his coat (x~700-760, y~1300-1560) is faded into fog here, while the mid layer keeps the exact painted pixels (hard vertical cut at his old silhouette)

walkPath.note: [x,y,scale] of the stand point (midpoint of the feet) — y beyond H lies on rock_ext; the figure is drawn scaled around its feet so at scale s the layer is placed with feet at (x,y). Scale >1 at the bottom = closer to the viewer. Painted wanderer height ≈ 944 px (layer h).

verify.compare: sky+far+mid+rock+wanderer vs main.webp, whole frame, decoded webp
